# E0609: dependency cycle

A package can't depend on itself, even through others. Move what both packages use into a package of its own.

- Rule: [`packages.dependency-cycles`](../../reference/04-programs.md#packages.dependency-cycles)
- Reported at: the first entry of the root's manifest through which a package of the cycle arrives.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `items` phase

## What the compiler prints

The program [`E0609_cycle`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0609_cycle):

`deps/a/src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
pub fn one() -> i64 { 1 }
```

`deps/a/stilt.toml`:

```text
[package]
name = "a"

[dependencies]
b = { path = "../../../../../conformance/packages/cycle_of_two/deps/b" }
```

`deps/b/src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
pub fn two() -> i64 { 2 }
```

`deps/b/stilt.toml`:

```text
[package]
name = "b"

[dependencies]
a = { path = "../../../../../conformance/packages/cycle_of_two/deps/a" }
```

`src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
fn main() / io { print("app") }
```

`stilt.toml`:

```text
[package]
name = "app"

[dependencies]
a = { path = "deps/a" }
```

What `stilt check` prints for it:

```text
── DEPENDENCY CYCLE ──────────────────────────────────── stilt.toml:5:1  [E0609]

`a` depends on itself, through the manifests of its dependencies:

  5 │ a = { path = "deps/a" }
    │ ^

A package can't depend on itself, even through others. Move what both packages
use into a package of its own.
```
